functional.title: Identity and access
functional.requirement: Authenticate actors; authorise workspace, organisation, group and proposal access on every request.

functional.title: Approved catalogue
functional.requirement: Venue managers maintain deliverable experiences, quotes, cultural anchors and available slots.

functional.title: Group brief
functional.requirement: Organisers record declared references, meanings, sharing consent, budget, group size and exact availability.

functional.title: Entity resolution
functional.requirement: Resolve references through Qloo search and obtain organiser selection for ambiguous results.

functional.title: Qloo discovery
functional.requirement: Fetch genuine server-side Qloo evidence and label live, cached, unavailable and synthetic modes.

functional.title: Interpretation and mapping
functional.requirement: Use venue-approved links between experience anchors and cultural entities; preserve declared meanings.

functional.title: Coalition formation
functional.requirement: Generate ranked feasible coalitions of two to four groups without violating hard constraints.

functional.title: Explanations
functional.requirement: Explain suitability, uncertainty and exclusions with valid evidence references.

functional.title: Versioned proposals
functional.requirement: Publish immutable terms; every material revision invalidates prior decisions and reservations.

functional.title: Group decisions
functional.requirement: Each included group organiser accepts or declines the current version and sharing arrangement.

functional.title: Reservations
functional.requirement: Each authenticated participant reserves one seat, subject to capacity and consent.

functional.title: Venue confirmation
functional.requirement: Confirm a reservation booking atomically only when readiness, slot and quote checks pass.

functional.title: Lifecycle recovery
functional.requirement: Handle withdrawal, cancellation, expiry and completion without hidden state changes.

functional.title: Agent job visibility
functional.requirement: Expose bounded job progress, failures, retries and in-app status changes.

functional.title: Public judge sandbox
functional.requirement: Create isolated synthetic workspaces for unauthenticated judges, with scoped role simulation.

functional.title: Privacy controls
functional.requirement: Provide consent choices, account export, deletion and retention enforcement.

functional.title: Evaluation evidence
functional.requirement: Record outcome events and comparable benchmark runs without claiming unmeasured improvement.

functional.title: Operator control
functional.requirement: Operators review venue eligibility, resolve support issues and audit privileged actions.

nonfunctional.title: Authorisation
nonfunctional.requirement: All role and cross-workspace negative tests pass; no client receives service credentials.

nonfunctional.title: Transaction integrity
nonfunctional.requirement: Zero over-capacity or duplicate active seat allocations under 50 concurrent attempts.

nonfunctional.title: Performance
nonfunctional.requirement: Targets: non-AI reads p95 <1 s; write transactions p95 <2 s; a bounded agent job finishes within 90 s or fails explicitly.

nonfunctional.title: Accessibility
nonfunctional.requirement: Target WCAG 2.2 AA; keyboard, focus, labels, contrast and reduced-motion checks on critical journeys.

nonfunctional.title: Recovery
nonfunctional.requirement: Reservation and confirmation retries are idempotent; interrupted jobs recover from a durable checkpoint.

nonfunctional.title: Provenance
nonfunctional.requirement: Every cultural rationale references an existing evidence record; source mode is visible.

nonfunctional.title: Privacy
nonfunctional.requirement: No names, email, raw access notes or invite tokens enter Qloo requests or public logs.

nonfunctional.title: Operability
nonfunctional.requirement: Trace a failed request using request_id and job_id without accessing participant taste text.

nonfunctional.title: Reproducibility
nonfunctional.requirement: Pinned dependencies, clean migrations and synthetic seeds reproduce the demo from a clean checkout.

nonfunctional.title: Availability
nonfunctional.requirement: Submission URL works externally and remains supported through judging; avoid unsupported SLA claims.
